about: The mutant ledger of runtime/v1, started by R3b (wf10, 2026-11-10) for rpc.Loopback's body RPCLocal. Each mutant names the rule it breaks and the test or example that kills it.

mutants.name: r3b-local-stop
mutants.rule: A stopped caller's Loopback Call ends with the stop, not with a defect read from the Interrupt the server answered, and after the call's release ran.

mutants.name: r3b-local-exit
mutants.rule: A Loopback Call reads the json Exit its server answered; the contract's laws hold through it.
killers: examples:limiter/loopback (ergo test: limits.Limiter laws for Loopback)
